name: order_analytics_concat_in_loop
description: Performance regression from replacing groupby aggregation with per-user pd.concat in loop

variants.name: exact_evidence
variants.description: Provides profiling data showing 1000x per-user filter as bottleneck

variants.name: misleading
variants.description: Points to Stage 1 data loading as bottleneck (real fix: replace concat-in-loop with groupby.agg)

success_criteria.description: Per-user report values unchanged from baseline

ground_truth.root_cause: pd.concat inside a loop over 1000 users — each concat copies the growing result DataFrame, plus per-user boolean scan over 200k rows
ground_truth.misleading_fix: Replace pd.concat with list accumulation + pd.DataFrame(rows) — avoids O(n²) copies (~47% improvement) but still scans 200k rows per user, still FAILS
ground_truth.correct_fix: Replace loop entirely with df.groupby('user_id').agg(...) — single pass, ~99% improvement, PASS
